credits.add.description: Adds a name to your end-of-stream credits, in any section. A name that is already in the section gets its count and amount raised.

parameters.section: The section: a built-in one like "follows", "raids" or "tips", or your own name like "Special thanks".
parameters.user: Optional. The name to show, like "CoolViewer42". Leave it out for the user of the trigger.
parameters.platform: Optional. The platform, like "twitch". Leave it out for the platform of the trigger.
parameters.amount: Optional. A number to add up, like 5 for a tip of 5. Leave it out for 0.
parameters.detail: Optional. Extra text shown with the name, like "Tier 1".

credits.add.returns: true. Fails when the section or the user is empty.

credits.get.description: Gives you the credits collected so far this stream, for your own credits overlay or a chat message.
credits.get.returns: An object with startedAt, updatedAt and sections. Each section has id, title and entries; each entry has user, platform, count, amount and detail.

credits.reset.description: Clears the credits, so the next stream starts empty.

credits.test.description: Gives you made-up sample credits, so you can design a credits overlay without waiting for a real stream. Your real credits do not change.
credits.test.returns: Sample credits in the same shape as credits.get (with isTest set to true).
